name: Point-and-figure triple-top breakout on ATR-scaled boxes
note: A.W. Cohen high/low point-and-figure chart with the box set to box_atr * ATR and refreshed every box_period bars, 3-box reversal. Long on a Triple Top Breakout (the live X column clears the tops of the two preceding X columns), short on the mirror; the exit is a Double Bottom Breakdown, a structural column event rather than a price stop. Time is thrown away: a bar that does not move price by a box does not advance the chart.
source: A.W. Cohen's high/low point-and-figure method; Double Top Breakout and Triple Top Breakout definitions verified from StockCharts ChartSchool 'P&F Classic Patterns' (fetched 2026-09-02): a Double Top Breakout is 'an X-column breaks above the high of the prior X-column' with an O-column between; the Triple Top requires two prior X-columns at equal highs and a third exceeding both, spanning five columns. Traditional box scaling from the ChartCraft table popularised by Thomas Dorsey; I substituted ATR-proportional boxes so the rule is symbol-agnostic and sweepable.
code:
def family_init(ctx):
    """Build A.W. Cohen high/low point-and-figure columns over the whole bar
    set in one causal pass, and record the column events the rule trades."""
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    hi = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    lo = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    cl = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]

    # Wilder ATR computed here rather than via ctx.indicator: the chart has to
    # be walked start to finish inside family_init, and an indicator Series
    # refuses forward reads while ctx is still sitting on bar 0.
    per = max(2, int(ctx.p.box_atr_n))
    atr = [None] * n
    acc = 0.0
    run = None
    for i in range(n):
        if i == 0:
            tr = hi[0] - lo[0]
        else:
            tr = max(hi[i] - lo[i], abs(hi[i] - cl[i - 1]), abs(lo[i] - cl[i - 1]))
        if i < per:
            acc += tr
            if i == per - 1:
                run = acc / per
                atr[i] = run
        else:
            run = (run * (per - 1) + tr) / per
            atr[i] = run

    rev = max(1, int(ctx.p.rev_boxes))
    need = max(1, int(ctx.p.tops) - 1)          # prior columns that must be cleared
    period = max(1, int(ctx.p.box_period))      # bars between box-size resets
    k = float(ctx.p.box_atr)

    long_e = [0.0] * n
    short_e = [0.0] * n
    exit_l = [0.0] * n
    exit_s = [0.0] * n

    col = 0            # +1 in an X column, -1 in an O column
    T = 0.0            # top of the live X column
    D = 0.0            # bottom of the live O column
    B = None           # box size, fixed for the current period
    xtops = []         # tops of completed X columns
    obots = []         # bottoms of completed O columns
    fx = fo = False    # entry already fired on this column
    dtb = dbb = False  # double top / bottom already flagged on this column
    reset_at = -10 ** 9

    for i in range(n):
        a = atr[i]
        if a is None or a <= 0:
            continue
        if B is None or (i - reset_at) >= period:
            B = round(k * a, 2)
            if B < 0.01:
                B = 0.01
            reset_at = i
        if col == 0:
            col = 1
            T = hi[i]
            fx = dtb = False
            continue

        adv_x = adv_o = False
        if col > 0:
            if hi[i] >= T + B:                       # extension wins over reversal
                T = T + int((hi[i] - T) / B) * B
                adv_x = True
            elif lo[i] <= T - rev * B:
                xtops.append(T)
                D = T - int((T - lo[i]) / B) * B
                col = -1
                fo = dbb = False
                adv_o = True
        else:
            if lo[i] <= D - B:
                D = D - int((D - lo[i]) / B) * B
                adv_o = True
            elif hi[i] >= D + rev * B:
                obots.append(D)
                T = D + int((hi[i] - D) / B) * B
                col = 1
                fx = dtb = False
                adv_x = True

        if adv_x:
            if xtops and not dtb and T > xtops[-1]:
                exit_s[i] = 1.0                      # double top breakout
                dtb = True
            if not fx and len(xtops) >= need and T > max(xtops[-need:]):
                long_e[i] = 1.0                      # triple top breakout
                fx = True
        if adv_o:
            if obots and not dbb and D < obots[-1]:
                exit_l[i] = 1.0                      # double bottom breakdown
                dbb = True
            if not fo and len(obots) >= need and D < min(obots[-need:]):
                short_e[i] = 1.0                     # triple bottom breakdown
                fo = True

    ctx.pf_long = ctx.series(long_e, "pf_long")
    ctx.pf_short = ctx.series(short_e, "pf_short")
    ctx.pf_xl = ctx.series(exit_l, "pf_exit_long")
    ctx.pf_xs = ctx.series(exit_s, "pf_exit_short")


def signal(ctx, i):
    if ctx.pf_long[i]:
        return 1
    if ctx.pf_short[i]:
        return -1
    return 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    """The whole exit: a long dies on a double bottom breakdown, a short on a
    double top breakout. No price stop -- the 3-box reversal already embeds
    one of rev * box_atr * ATR."""
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    if ctx.positions[0]["side"] == "long":
        return bool(ctx.pf_xl[i])
    return bool(ctx.pf_xs[i])
